# LZHAM

> LZ77 parsing over 32 KB hash chains (matches of 3 to 258 bytes, at most 64 chain probes) with the literal/length and distance alphabets coded by canonical Huffman codes whose code-length table is written verbatim ahead of the token stream. Byte-for-byte identical to CompressionWorkbench's BB_LZHAM reference block. This is the LZ-plus-Huffman formulation of the design, not the production LZHAM codec's adaptive binary range coder with rep-match slots.
